Overview

Zenica is a city in Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina with a population of 110,000. An industrial city in central Bosnia on the Bosna River, known for its steel mill and the nearby medieval town of Vranduk. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
